Download the complete byte-exact contents of the remaining files of the `photo-abstract-editorial` skill (v3.0.0) from the public GitHub repo `kwhi6693-web/photo-abstract-editorial` (branch `main`) and write them to disk.

RELIABLE METHOD (use this, it was proven to work): the GitHub Contents API returns base64 content and is NOT truncated by the fetch tool:
  https://api.github.com/repos/kwhi6693-web/photo-abstract-editorial/contents/<path>
Use `web_fetch` on that API URL (which returns JSON with a "content" field), base64-decode it, and write the file. Verify each file's decoded blob SHA-1 matches the "sha" field returned by the API, so you can prove byte-exactness.

Base destination directory: `D:\DeepSeek\任务\Skill\.dsh\skills\photo-abstract-editorial\`

Files to fetch and their destination paths (all repo paths are relative to the repo root):

1. `scripts/remove_chroma_key.py`      -> `scripts\remove_chroma_key.py`
2. `scripts/validate_editorial.py`     -> `scripts\validate_editorial.py`
3. `assets/examples/source-horizon.png` -> `assets\examples\source-horizon.png`   (binary PNG; base64-decode properly)
4. `assets/examples/result-horizon.png` -> `assets\examples\result-horizon.png`   (binary PNG; base64-decode properly)
5. `agents/openai.yaml`                -> `agents\openai.yaml`
6. `references/control-system.md`      -> `references\control-system.md`
7. `references/scene-profiles.md`      -> `references\scene-profiles.md`
8. `references/layout-profiles.md`     -> `references\layout-profiles.md`
9. `references/art-direction.md`       -> `references\art-direction.md`
10. `references/quality-check.md`      -> `references\quality-check.md`
11. `references/series-style.md`       -> `references\series-style.md`
12. `references/example-pair.md`       -> `references\example-pair.md`
13. `LICENSE`                          -> `LICENSE`
14. `requirements.txt`                 -> `requirements.txt`  (if it exists; skip silently if 404)

Notes:
- Create directories as needed.
- If a file 404s, note it and continue with the rest.
- Do NOT reformat, re-indent, strip or "clean" any file. Write exactly the decoded bytes. Write binary files as raw bytes (in Python, open with `wb`), and text files as UTF-8 (`wb` is fine for both).
- The GitHub API has a rate limit (60 req/hr unauthenticated). If you hit a 403 rate limit, wait/retry, or fall back to the truncated `web_fetch` only for the small `.md` reference files (they are short enough not to truncate).
- Use the bundled Python (from the `load_workspace_dependencies` tool) for base64 decoding and SHA-1 verification.

Finally, run this verification in pwsh and include the output in your report:
  python -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) and None for p in [r'D:\DeepSeek\任务\Skill\.dsh\skills\photo-abstract-editorial\scripts\remove_chroma_key.py', r'D:\DeepSeek\任务\Skill\.dsh\skills\photo-abstract-editorial\scripts\validate_editorial.py']]; print('SCRIPTS SYNTAX OK')"

Report: for EACH file — destination path, byte size, whether the SHA-1 matched the API sha, and any failures. Be concise and factual.
